root_cause: PR delivery duplicated domain checks and website builds across preflight and lane jobs, while repeated dependency installs and unnecessary local browser builds consumed runner time even when an exact-SHA Netlify preview already existed.
prevention_rule: Keep one PR-scoped Required authority, classify before expensive work, cancel superseded same-PR runs, use lockfile-bound dependency caches, avoid duplicate domain checks, reuse the exact-SHA Netlify preview for browser verification, and build locally only as a fail-safe fallback.

observed_duplicate_patterns: preflight repeated Supabase security independent of lane
preflight repeated Portal suite independent of lane
website page-seo rebuilt candidate after Netlify build parity
browser rebuilt candidate even when exact Netlify preview could be ready
multiple npm installs without lockfile cache reuse
